name: 朱红·日经
description: 源自 rico-md 的「朱红·日经」主题（MIT, ricocc/rico-md）。

root.html: <section style="max-width: 100%; margin: 0 auto; padding: 12px 14px 36px 14px; font-family: Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, Yu Gothic, Noto Sans SC, Meiryo, sans-serif; font-size: 14.5px; line-height: 1.78; color: {{text}}; background-color: #fff; word-wrap: break-word">{{content}}</section>

title.html: <{{tag}} style="font-size: 22px; font-weight: 700; color: {{heading}}; line-height: 1.35; margin: 22px 0 12px; padding-bottom: 8px; border-bottom: 2px solid {{heading}}">{{content}}</{{tag}}>

heading.html: <{{tag}} style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 700; color: {{codeText}}; line-height: 1.4; margin: 20px 0 10px; padding-left: 10px; border-left: 3px solid {{codeText}}">{{content}}</{{tag}}>

heading3.html: <{{tag}} style="font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; color: {{text}}; line-height: 1.45; margin: 16px 0 8px; padding: 4px 8px; background-color: #f7f7f7">{{content}}</{{tag}}>

inlineCode.html: {{content}}

code.html: {{content}}

quote.html: {{content}}

link.html: {{content}}

tableHead.html: <th style="background-color: {{codeText}}; color: #fff; padding: 7px 10px; text-align: left; font-weight: 700; font-size: 11.5px; letter-spacing: 0.03em">{{content}}</th>

table.html: {{thead}}{{tbody}}
